scope: Static-only patch: add direct unified batch return to pasted-TID Finder and selection toolbar.

behavior.label: 整批退回，统一复查
behavior.flow: acceptance_fail, acceptanceInspection=uninspected, shared acceptanceBatchId, per-task expectedUpdatedAt
behavior.quality: No actual inspection result is inferred; first accuracy excludes these uninspected dispositions, including later reinspection. Existing actual results retain their meaning.
behavior.note: Default fixed explanation; supplemental note optional, at most 1960 characters.
behavior.guards: One group, fixed selected tasks, stale updates reject all and retain drafts; unknown/processed TIDs are reported by existing Finder validation.

deployment.rollback: Restore backed-up index only. Keep prod74 API and all immutable assets.
